definitions.explanation: The color between red and yellow, named after the daidai (bitter orange) fruit. One of the traditional Japanese color names.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{橙色|だいだいいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まった→染まる：04254_somaru⟧。
{橙色|だいだいいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦セーター→セーター：01371_seetaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。

⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{橙色|だいだいいろ}や⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{色|いろ}づく→色づく：10074_irozuku⟧。
examples.english: When autumn foliage season arrives, the mountains turn orange and red.

notes:
Named after ⟦{橙|だいだい}→橙：21180_daidai⟧, the bitter orange (Citrus aurantium), a citrus fruit traditionally used in New Year decorations. {橙色|だいだいいろ} is the native Japanese word for the color orange.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {橙色|だいだいいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まる→染まる：04254_somaru⟧: to be dyed/tinged orange
- {橙色|だいだいいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧: orange light
- {橙色|だいだいいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧: orange flower

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦オレンジ→オレンジ：01044_orenji⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: orange — the loanword version, more commonly used in everyday conversation
- {橙色|だいだいいろ}: the traditional Japanese term, used in formal or literary contexts and in art

CULTURAL NOTE:
{橙色|だいだいいろ} is one of the seven colors of the rainbow in Japanese (⟦{虹|にじ}→虹：03894_niji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{七色|なないろ}→七色：08734_nanairo⟧). The ⟦{橙|だいだい}→橙：21180_daidai⟧ fruit itself is an auspicious symbol placed on top of ⟦{鏡餅|かがみもち}→鏡餅：19469_kagamimochi⟧ during New Year because its name is a homophone for ⟦{代々|だいだい}→代々：05899_daidai⟧ (generation after generation).
